about: expected answer of a reader for each file (tools/meter_settings.py is the reference; sim/test_p2_mset_vectors.py proves the firmware's C code agrees); records are in file order, oldest first; lookups use the active generation only; seq compares in serial arithmetic

files.what: the zero-filled seed Omega or the installer creates: no generation, defaults
8,192 bytes of 0xFF (the Pocket's own fill when a file is missing, bit 5): no generation
a fresh file after one edit: bank A, seq 1, one record
two edits: bank A holds seq 1 (one record), bank B seq 2 (two records): the larger seq wins, so bank B
three edits: bank A seq 3 wins over bank B seq 2; three records, oldest first; the third is params_rev 2 with preset 3
the first meter edited again: its record moves to the END (recency order) and replaces the old one
an edit with no entries removes the meter's record (B): two records left
40 meters with 40 changed parameters each (5,120 bytes of records, more than a generation holds): the oldest meters were evicted, the newest are intact; used <= 4,076
three_records.bin with one bit flipped inside a record of the newest generation (bank A): its CRC fails, so the older generation (bank B, seq 2, two records) is used
three_records.bin with a bit of the newest generation's stored CRC flipped: same outcome, the older generation is used
one bit flipped inside a record of each generation: no valid generation, defaults
three_records.bin with version 2 in the newest generation's header (a file from a future Tau): the whole file is ignored (status locked): no record of either generation is used and nothing is written
three_records.bin cut by one byte: not an 8,192-byte file, so the Pocket does not load it (size_exact) and a reader says size
three_records.bin with one byte appended: size
bank A seq 0xFFFFFFFF, bank B seq 0: serial arithmetic says 0 is NEWER, so bank B wins (a plain 'larger number wins' would pick bank A)
the same two generations the other way round: bank A seq 0, bank B seq 0xFFFFFFFF: bank A wins
bank A seq 0x7FFFFFFF, bank B seq 0x80000000: the difference is +1, so bank B wins (a signed 32-bit compare of the seqs themselves would pick A)
bank A seq 0x80000000, bank B seq 0x7FFFFFFF: bank A wins
